notes.title: Steam Achievements Are Here in Skyward Dream!
notes.content:
Skyward Dream now features Steam Achievements! 

As you journey through the surreal layers of your mind, you'll now have the added challenge of unlocking achievements tied to your progress, exploration, and personal growth.

If you've already started your journey, don't worry! You will unlock all of the achievements tied to your progress up to the point you've reached when you start the game, so no need to start over—just continue exploring!

Ready to unlock your potential? Start your journey now and earn those achievements!

notes.title: Updated Demo for Skyward Dream is Now Available!
notes.content:
Curious about what lies deep within your mind? You can now experience the updated demo of Skyward Dream! This demo offers polished features and an intriguing glimpse into the full adventure, perfect for you if you're eager to explore the dreamy, surreal world of the game.

In this demo, you’ll:


 Experience the game’s introduction and step into the unknown
 Uncover hidden memories and confront the mysterious voice during Sleep Paralysis
 Get a taste of the challenging and atmospheric journey that lies ahead


Ready to dive deeper? Try the updated demo now!

notes.title: Skyward Dream is Now Available! Plus, Exciting Updates Coming Soon
notes.content:
After 9 months of hard work, Skyward Dream is finally finished and ready for you to experience! What began as a simple game-jam idea during the 7DFPS game jam on December 8th, 2023, has transformed into something much bigger than I originally envisioned. Back in January, I made the decision to expand this concept into a full-fledged game—and now, it’s here.

What’s included in the final product?


 First-Person Platforming – The heart of the game is all about navigating a dreamy world through your platforming abilities.
 Abilities That Grow With You – As you progress, you’ll unlock new skills that help you tackle increasingly complex challenges, mirroring your growth within the game.
 Pages of Your Mind – Dive deep into the layers of your subconscious, uncovering memories and thoughts hidden within your mind. Collect all the pieces to continue your journey.
 Sleep Paralysis Cycle – The game focuses on the stages of sleep, with a unique twist in the Sleep Paralysis stage where a floating, interactable book becomes central to your exploration.
 Layered Exploration – The Deep Sleep stage now consists of multiple Layers, each symbolizing an internal struggle like Fear of Transformation or Overthinking.
 Intriguing Storyline – Discover who you are, the identity of the mysterious voice in the Sleep Paralysis stage, and whether escape from your own mind is even possible.


What’s Next for Skyward Dream?

I’m committed to making Skyward Dream even better in the coming months! Here are some exciting updates that are planned to arrive before the end of 2024:


 Steam Achievements – If you’re a fan of unlocking achievements (like me!), you’ll be happy to know that achievements are coming soon. Track your progress and show off your accomplishments as you explore the game.
 New Game+ Mode – For those looking to experience the story again with everything unlocked and a greater challenge, New Game+ will give you a fresh perspective once you’ve completed the main story.
 Challenge Mode – Are you a speedrunner or someone who thrives on overcoming tough obstacles? Challenge Mode will bring a higher level of difficulty designed specifically for you.
 Relax Mode – If you’re in the mood for something more laid-back, Relax Mode lets you jump and explore an endless path without the pressure of completing objectives. Perfect for those moments when you just want to unwind.


These updates are planned to be released before the end of 2024, bringing even more depth and replayability to Skyward Dream.

With all these new features on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to jump into the dream world. So what are you waiting for? Go ahead, explore, and discover the dreams you never knew you had!

Buy Skyward Dream now and start your adventure!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused Hovering Book Page Turn SFX to play multiple times when the mouse button is pressed continuously.
 Fixed the problem with the missing Pause menu SFX in The Sleep Paralysis stage.
 Added a key prompt in The Sleep Paralysis stage for clarity.
 Now you can continue from The Sleep Paralysis stage when you click on the back cover of the book, as well.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update is Out!
notes.content:
The new major Demo update is out for Steam Next Fest! Try it now!

Thank you for playing the Demo, reporting bugs, and giving feedback!

Based on all of your feedback, here is an updated Demo for the game!

What's New:

 Save System - The game now autosaves to the last checkpoint reached!
 Improved gameplay - Game Feel, Character Controller, Mechanics, Physics.
 Level design improvement - Fixed areas causing players to get stuck.
 Settings menu - You can now change graphics, audio, and gameplay settings!
 Improved story - Cutscenes change for a better story delivery.
 And lots of small bug fixes and improvements.


Make sure you see "Build Version: 0.1.1" in the bottom right corner!

Also, don't forget to wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2776230/Skyward_Dream/
